decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component technology tied to the firm's established air-cooler business and its announced efficiency direction, so the sunk engineering and manufacturing investment favors persisting despite limited visibility since 2019.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's R&D-driven core know-how and support its efficiency and sustainability promises, so management would keep investing in them rather than write off the prior development effort.
